# Seoul vector tile fixture

The adjacent JSON records the downloaded tile URL and coordinates. The PBF is
an unmodified OpenFreeMap tile using the OpenMapTiles schema, retained to test
real geometry decoding without a live network dependency.

[ODbL](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/).

Provider: [OpenFreeMap](https://openfreemap.org/quick_start/).
